note: The OLG has a dedicated page 'Rental, Roomer, and Boarder Income SNAP' (SNAP > Eligibility Requirements > Income > Self Employment) that thoroughly covers both FNS requirements. It requires workers to (1) determine monthly rental income received from tenants, (2) subtract the Cost of Doing Business (CODB), and (3) prorate CODB by number of units. A detailed worked example with a three-family house illustrates the calculation. The 'Self-Employment SNAP' page lists all allowable and disallowed CODB items (principal, interest, taxes, insurance, utilities on income-producing property, etc.). The Verification Chart lists self-employment income and business records as mandatory verification items (Schedule C, 1099, business records). The OLG also addresses the earned vs. unearned classification of rental income based on the 20-hour management threshold. Both elements of FNS 1045.3 — verifying gross rental income and verifying/excluding costs of doing business — are fully covered.
